brief:
A building collapse in Gaza killed twelve children this week, Zeteo reported. The incident occurred as Israel continues military operations in the territory following the outbreak of conflict.

The Trump administration is planning to send Israel 2,000-pound bombs, according to the outlet's weekly coverage. The developments mark significant escalations in both the immediate humanitarian toll and the scale of military support reaching Israeli forces.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Building collapse kills twelve children in Gaza amid ongoing conflict
